say:1:1322510001:1.text: Magister, there is one more thing I need to ask of you.
say:1:1322510001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，有件事情需要麻烦您。
say:1:1322510001:1.male: Magister, there is one more thing I need to ask of you.
say:1:1322510001:1.female: Magister, there is one more thing I need to ask of you.

say:2:1322510002:1.text: The duchy's been in turmoil lately—things aren't quite back to normal. A few days ago, some rogue servants took advantage of the chaos at Valesa Castle and made off with some valuables.
say:2:1322510002:1.source_cn: 最近公国突逢异变，秩序尚未恢复。前几天，有居心不良的城...
say:2:1322510002:1.male: The duchy's been in turmoil lately—things aren't quite back to normal. A few days ago, some rogue servants took advantage of the chaos at Valesa Castle and made off with some valuables.
say:2:1322510002:1.female: The duchy's been in turmoil lately—things aren't quite back to normal. A few days ago, some rogue servants took advantage of the chaos at Valesa Castle and made off with some valuables.

say:3:1322510003:1.text: A villager reported seeing suspicious figures near the western outskirts of the town.
say:3:1322510003:1.source_cn: 我接到报告，有村民目击到一帮形迹可疑的人员逃到了雪松镇...
say:3:1322510003:1.male: A villager reported seeing suspicious figures near the western outskirts of the town.
say:3:1322510003:1.female: A villager reported seeing suspicious figures near the western outskirts of the town.

say:4:1322510004:1.text: These thieves are slippery. They've evaded the guards multiple times. Would you be willing to track them down?
say:4:1322510004:1.source_cn: 这帮匪徒非常狡猾，已经几次逃脱公国卫兵的追捕，如果您不...
say:4:1322510004:1.male: These thieves are slippery. They've evaded the guards multiple times. Would you be willing to track them down?
say:4:1322510004:1.female: These thieves are slippery. They've evaded the guards multiple times. Would you be willing to track them down?

say:0:1322511001:0.text: We're getting close to the area now.
say:0:1322511001:0.source_cn: 提到的郊野应该就在这附近了。

say:1:1322511002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们在附近搜查下吧！

say:0:1322512001:0.text: They're up to something shady, no doubt about it!
say:0:1322512001:0.source_cn: 这帮人鬼鬼祟祟的，肯定有问题！

say:1:1322513001:1.text: I'll talk! I'll tell you everything. Just don't kill me!
say:1:1322513001:1.source_cn: 我招！我全都招！只要别杀我，我什么都愿意交代！

say:2:1322513002:1.text: Don't try anything funny! You didn't just steal this small stash, did you?! Where's the rest of it?
say:2:1322513002:1.source_cn: 哼，别想耍花样！你们偷到的东西肯定不止这么一点，老实说...

say:3:1322513003:1.text: Alright, alright! We... we hid them under a tree, south of here...
say:3:1322513003:1.source_cn: 我说，我说……我们都……都藏在树下了……就是南边的那棵树……

say:0:1322515001:0.text: Got everything! Magister, let's bring these back to Rodrigo!
say:0:1322515001:0.source_cn: 拿到了！主人！我们回去交给罗德里戈吧！

say:1:1322516001:1.text: Thanks to your help, we managed to catch the thieves and return the stolen goods. The court's reputation is saved.
say:1:1322516001:1.source_cn: 多亏了您的出手相助，既抓到了盗匪，又找回了赃物，挽回了...
say:1:1322516001:1.male: Thanks to your help, we managed to catch the thieves and return the stolen goods. The court's reputation is saved.
say:1:1322516001:1.female: Thanks to your help, we managed to catch the thieves and return the stolen goods. The court's reputation is saved.

say:2:1322516002:1.text: Those thieves are all locked up now, waiting for their trial. You've done us a great service!
say:2:1322516002:1.source_cn: 那些人已经全数下狱，正在等待审查。感谢您的帮助！
say:2:1322516002:1.male: Those thieves are all locked up now, waiting for their trial. You've done us a great service!
say:2:1322516002:1.female: Those thieves are all locked up now, waiting for their trial. You've done us a great service!
